inputs.text: John Lahart of Fianna Fáil is pushing to change inheritance-tax exemptions, and colleagues have made similar calls. They frame it as a fairness issue for people without children, but the coordinated timing suggests a broader effort to reshape who gets to keep or inherit wealth. “Fairness” may be a cover story; the real question is whose interests the changes would serve.
